data.title: Water Rising
data.passage: Heavy spring rains fill local streams with rapid currents. As a result, water spills over the grassy banks onto nearby streets. Families must leave their houses quickly when water rises too high. To fix this, workers build tall walls along the river edges. Similarly, engineers dig deep ditches to carry extra water away. These changes help keep neighborhoods dry.
